result.brief: 提出 PreAct-Nav 智能体导航框架，用动作条件世界模型沙盒预测候选动作后果，并结合导航记忆与 VLM 推理更新中程子目标。
result.reason: Uses an action-conditioned world model to forecast dynamics for embodied urban navigation, with memory-based subgoal reasoning; main contribution is navigation policy/planning, so it maps to the applications direction.
